_comment: Variant I — QUANT-6 regime-conditional entry rules. Tests whether different regimes deserve different entry_quality bars. Hypothesis: choppy regime late-entries (VALID/PULLBACK) suffer disproportionately because choppy = mean-reverting; only FRESH near pivots survive. Trending regime tolerates PULLBACK because trends carry through. Run via: python3 backtest.py --portfolio --days 250 --config-override config/variants/I_regime_entry_rules.json

regime4_thresholds._comment: QUANT-6 — entry_quality_rules per regime. Map of entry_quality → verdict override. Empty/missing = use global.

risk_on_trending._eq_rationale: Trending: full breadth — accept FRESH/PULLBACK/VALID. Trends carry through late entries.

risk_on_choppy._eq_rationale: Choppy: ONLY FRESH allowed. Late entries get whipsawed in mean-reverting tape.

risk_off_trending._eq_rationale: Risk-off: tight bar — only FRESH near pivot. Anything else = pass.

panic._eq_rationale: Panic: no longs regardless of entry quality.

_caveat: Bands are HYPOTHETICAL — based on the principle that choppy regimes are mean-reverting (so late entries fail) and trending regimes are momentum-carry (so late entries can still work). Needs per-regime entry-quality attribution backtest for validation.
